description: Source code for procurement scheduling and automation in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point confirmation.

classes.name: mrp_procurement
classes.description: Odoo model class extending 'mrp.procurement' with methods for procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point processing.

methods.name: _procure_confirm
methods.description: Confirms procurement orders, validates workflows, and generates a report on procurement status.

methods.name: create_automatic_op
methods.description: Creates automatic procurement orders for products with negative virtual availability.

methods.name: _procure_orderpoint_confirm
methods.description: Processes stock warehouse order points, creating procurement orders as needed.
